# Bitfroest.fs 0.0.53

Changes since version [0.0.52](https://github.com/s-a/Bitfroest.fs/releases/tag/v0.0.52).

## Improved

- The Marketplace summary highlights side-by-side file management, folder tabs, search, and local Git status. Backup guidance remains in the README.

## Fixed

- Closing the active folder tab automatically loads the next tab's file list, including when a directory refresh is already running.
- File list columns remain readable after closing Quick Diff, even if the lists were updated in the background.
- Returning to the window checks for changes without rebuilding unchanged views. X-Ray and Quick Diff preserve the scroll position when the displayed file is updated.

## Updating

Update Bitfroest.fs to 0.0.53 through the VS Code Extensions view on the pre-release channel. Packages are available for Windows x64 and Linux x64. The Apple Silicon package remains experimental.
